name: Fifth Golden Dating Era of a Cafe Owner
overview: Su Bin has just opened her own cafe, and a situationship with 5 men in a coffee-scented cafe begins. With fox boy, rich boy, dark boy, puppy boy, and nerdy boy, she remembers that love can be happy when she is shown the correct way of loving. A 1st person view of a cafe owner and 5 different men, who will be the one to win her heart?
